title.zh: 将马尼拉市马努吉特街（国道）更名为何塞·阿巴德·桑托斯街的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Manuguit Street, a National Highway in the City of Manila, to Jose Abad Santos Street
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Manuguit Street, a National Highway in the City of Manila, to Jose Abad Santos Street
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Manuguit Street, a National Highway tại Thành phố Manila thành Jose Abad Santos Street
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Manuguit Street, a National Highway ในเมือง Manila เป็น Jose Abad Santos Street
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Manuguit Street, a National Highway di Kota Manila menjadi Jose Abad Santos Street
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Manuguit Street, a National Highway di Bandaraya Manila menjadi Jose Abad Santos Street

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1256_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Manuguit Street, a national highway in the City of Manila, shall hereafter be known as Jose Abad Santos Street.

This Act take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1955.
